# Ask HR Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Ask HR Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template.** These runbooks and agents are examples. They cover the full path to a production build and must be modified to meet each customer's specific requirements. The customer or their partner connects them to their own systems, identity, data and governance in their environment.

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist). Routine HR inquiry volume by policy category and repeated explanation work. Identify the guidance employees wait for and agree customer success measures before building. [Source](../../solutions/catalog.json)

Record your baseline; no values are supplied:

| Category | Measurement period | Inquiry volume | Policy source | Content owner | Escalation route |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Review [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract). Record adaptations and approval boundaries; assign these roles before configuration.

| Role | Responsibility | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HR business owner | Approve the policy sources, employee-facing scope and escalation workflow; agree production success measures without treating fictional balances as customer results. | [FIELD-GUIDE.md](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |
| Authorized HR and benefits reviewers | Verify eligibility, exceptions and plan rules through the approved HR workflow; retain decisions that the policy-explanation and draft skills must not make. | [GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md](../../solutions/ask-hr/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md) |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and six skills; remove web search, preserve model parity and record the owned agent's Draft state. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing and capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before approving any HR production connection. | [Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/security-and-governance) |
| HR source and connection owners | Approve HRIS, benefits and policy access; record each connection identity and least-privilege reference, and resolve access failures before a production test. | [catalog.json](../../solutions/catalog.json) |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check HR-01 through HR-06, the refusal tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject missing citations, incomplete inventory captures and Draft badges belonging to other agents. | [FIELD-GUIDE.md](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring, and configuration recovery; send individualized HR determinations to the authorized reviewers. | [Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview) |

### Step 0-3. Qualify

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **HR business owner**. Agree HR replacement connections, governance, support, telemetry and success measures before production. [Basis](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] HR production replacements, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] The HR owner records inquiry categories and repeated guidance work before agreeing customer success measures. [Source](../../solutions/catalog.json)

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Apply the identity design

**Owner:** Template

Use the [identity and permissions design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and supplied [settings](../../solutions/ask-hr/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml) as the starting contract.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Approve environment, audience, connection identities and denied-access tests. [Authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) · [Data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Step 1-3. Secure

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Power Platform administrator**. Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The source-controlled build uses cli-copilot in the approved environment and remains Draft. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)
- [ ] The customer confirms authenticated audience and least-privilege access for restricted HR information. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication)

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Select one build lane

**Owner:** Template

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted source-controlled authoring | Verified Copilot Studio Draft on synthetic data |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Makers building and reviewing in the browser; no local tooling | The same verified Draft and replayed locked cases |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Learning and changing portable behavior; local Brainstem is optional | Synthetic behavior proof, followed by native Draft validation |

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template

**Easy mode:** attach the [Copilot authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and follow the [reviewed build messages](../../solutions/ask-hr/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md).

**Manual:** create a Draft, save [global instructions](../../solutions/ask-hr/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md), upload the 2 [knowledge files](2.Architecture.md#knowledge-inventory) and 6 [skills](2.Architecture.md#skill-inventory), wait for ingestion, and confirm model `Sonnet46`. Use the [manual tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/ask-hr/manual-tutorial.html).

**Portable learning:** optionally install `ask_hr_agent.py` with [the deployment recipe](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json) and verify its expected tool `AskHRAgent`. This does not replace customer tenant configuration.

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template

| Rule ID | Required handling | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| evidence-no-mockups | A required evidence file is missing: Stop. Capture or restore the real file; never substitute a mockup. | [Package rule](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |
| failed-case-no-cherry-picking | A recorded identifier is absent: Mark the case failed and investigate; do not retry until it happens to pass. | [Package rule](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |
| draft-publication-stop | Publish is offered: Stop at Draft unless a separate approver explicitly authorizes publication. | [Package rule](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |

Package rules: [failure recovery](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md#failure-recovery).

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** retain a fresh result for every locked case: HR-01, HR-02, HR-03, HR-04, HR-05, HR-06. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's HR Preview results identify the agent, model, inventory and Draft state. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `AskHRAgent` and returns its required markers. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)
- [ ] Record optional-track completion or non-use; do not claim validation for an omitted lane. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, six skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/manual-build-evidence.json)
- [ ] Unchanged HR prompts pass in fresh Preview chats on the owned, unpublished manual agent. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] Full-response assertions establish each HR case pass; cropped screenshots do not replace the machine gate. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/visual-checkpoints.json)
- [ ] Chosen-lane evidence is complete; any Easy/Manual comparison uses identical instructions, knowledge, skills and model. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

Use the [integration contracts](2.Architecture.md#integration-points). Bind the approved connector, flow or API read-only first; enable writes only after separate authorization and testing.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Approved HRIS and benefits systems

**Owner:** Customer or partner

**Approved HRIS and benefits systems contract:** Profile, balance and plan contracts backed by fictional records; no live lookup.

**Wire Approved HRIS and benefits systems:** Bind scoped read-only connector or API actions ([Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/add-tools-custom-agent)). Verify [field mapping](2.Architecture.md#data-contract) and access; writes require approval. [Source](../../state/architecture_level2_sources/ask-hr.json)

**Connect — HR source and connection owners.** Create dedicated references only for approved HR systems and verify least-privilege access. [Basis](../../solutions/catalog.json)

### Step 3-2. Integrate Approved policy knowledge source

**Owner:** Customer or partner

**Approved policy knowledge source contract:** Fixed policy records and privacy rules used by the packaged skills.

**Wire Approved policy knowledge source:** Add approved policy knowledge and its content owner ([Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/knowledge-copilot-studio)). Verify [field mapping](2.Architecture.md#data-contract) and access; writes require approval. [Source](../../state/architecture_level2_sources/ask-hr.json)

### Step 3-3. Integrate Authorized HR reviewer workflow

**Owner:** Customer or partner

**Authorized HR reviewer workflow contract:** Reviewable drafts and explicit human handoffs; no submission or notification tool.

**Wire Authorized HR reviewer workflow:** Keep drafts read-only; gate an authorized workflow before any write ([Learn, preview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/tools-add-workflow)). Verify [field mapping](2.Architecture.md#data-contract) and access; writes require approval. [Source](../../state/architecture_level2_sources/ask-hr.json)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Customer-approved connections preserve the reviewed HR input/output contract; no live result is claimed without tool evidence. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] Identity-scoped employee access, data minimization, retention and audit controls are verified before personal data is used. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/manual/knowledge/aibast_ask-hr-rules-and-guardrails.md)

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Template

Use [locked cases and expected evidence](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases). Replace fictional records with approved customer fixtures while preserving the tested behavior.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner

The business owner sets thresholds and representative populations. Re-run cases on authorized customer data, including denied identities and source failures. Record expected versus actual results; template counts are not production thresholds.

### Step 4-3. Test

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Acceptance reviewer**. Test an approved deployment as intended HR users and an unshared identity; maker access does not prove user connection access. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The business owner agrees customer-data success measures; fictional fixture values are not customer acceptance thresholds. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] Adapted evaluations identify the tested version and authenticated user profile; exact assertions remain separate from General quality scoring. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro)

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template

These gates concern the synthetic reference build, not production thresholds. Its workshop copy stays Draft; the customer evaluates and publishes their adapted build separately.

| Template gate | Required evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Locked HR corpus | All six cases, HR-01 through HR-06, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. | [ask-hr.json](../../tests/demo_cases/ask-hr.json) |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, six skills and the reviewed model; no tools or web search. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Privacy and human authority | Any sensitive inference, eligibility decision, plan recommendation, submission or notification is no-go. | [GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md](../../solutions/ask-hr/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md) |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Require a visible target-state anchor without a defeating blocker; withhold reshoot-required captures. | [visual-checkpoints.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/visual-checkpoints.json) |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |

### Step 5-2. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Approve a limited audience and compare outcomes with the baseline. Resolve safety and access failures, then record go/no-go against your thresholds.

### Step 5-3. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Approve the version, channels, audience and support handoff. Publish after the pilot decision and verify permitted and denied access. [Publish and share guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent).

### Step 5-4. Release: approval

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **HR business owner**. Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation. [Basis](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation. [Source](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json)
- [ ] The approved HR audience and supported channels are configured, tested and confirmed before publication. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/publication-publish-agent)

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template

Use [state and recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery), the regression cases and the [package failure guidance](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md#failure-recovery) as a starting playbook; design and test customer-specific recovery.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate after source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitoring guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Copilot Studio maker**. Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/developer/cli/reference/copilot)

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Power Platform administrator**. Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)

### Step 6-5. Operate

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Operations owner**. Review HR session transcripts, failed interactions, tool authentication errors and credit usage in Monitor. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the chosen environment type and target. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview)

## Deliverables Checklist

### Template provides

- [ ] The agent behavior, synthetic data contract and a single skills/knowledge inventory.
- [ ] Declared integration and identity designs, locked cases, boundary tests and integrity rules.
- [ ] The build, pilot, rollout and operations playbooks linked throughout this runbook.

### Customer or partner delivers

- [ ] Adapted requirements, source mappings, tenant identities, data policies and approved connections.
- [ ] Evaluation on customer data with business-owned thresholds and documented go/no-go.
- [ ] Authorized publication, channels, audience, operations ownership and tested recovery.
